dimensions.note: No credentials are accepted; secret-bearing URL components and failure messages are rejected or omitted.
All validation, hashing, and replay conflict checks precede persistence.
Identical replay is a no-op; conflicting reuse of deterministic identity is rejected.
Input is bounded before allocation; no persistent handles or temporary files are created.
Arguments, Playwright input, and output use strict bounded schemas.
Append-only evidence recorder, not a CRUD lifecycle model.
No external mutation or authority; only validated evidence persistence.
Safe bounded environment and run IDs form one deterministic instance name.
Replay state is read through readResource.
